reading.body:
Layer42 Santa Clara is located at Raymond Street in Santa Clara County, California, but the operator's website is unreachable and no published power capacity specification exists for this facility. The research team found a valid street address and verified the operator name as of September 2026, but could not access operator documentation to confirm what services this campus provides or what load it can support. Without published specifications, this facility cannot be ranked or assessed against California's data center infrastructure.

California has 103 mapped data center facilities, of which 11 have published power capacity totaling 365 MW. This campus does not appear in the published capacity dataset and thus ranks outside the state's top ten disclosed facilities. The state's largest disclosed operations range from facilities in the double-digit to low three-digit megawatt range, though most mapped facilities publish no figures at all.

The Layer42 Santa Clara location remains a research lead pending restoration of the operator's published specifications or alternative sources. Until capacity figures are available, this site cannot inform decisions about AI infrastructure scale or grid impact.
